summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Microsoft SSO fix. Created new pytest suite (test_microsoft_sso.py) with 9 tests covering the /api/auth/microsoft endpoint using forged idTokens (backend does not verify signature - HS256 with any key works). All required scenarios PASS: success with valid domain+tenant+group claim (user created, cookies set, /auth/me works), wrong domain rejected 403, correct domain without group claim rejected 403, correct domain with wrong group id rejected 403, wrong tenant rejected 403. Bypass admin login and Dataverse regression (/api/dataverse/socios returns 327 records with new Azure secret) also PASS. Frontend: /admin/login renders MS button (enabled), bypass login flow works, MS button uses loginRedirect (same tab) to login.microsoftonline.com with correct redirect_uri=/admin/login. Full backend regression: 51/51 pytest tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: SECURITY: /api/auth/microsoft decodes idToken with verify_signature=False. This means anyone with knowledge of tenant id, group id, and allowed domain can forge a JWT via HS256 with any random secret and gain admin access to MongoDB (as demonstrated in the tests). Recommend: fetch Azure JWKS from https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant}/discovery/v2.0/keys and verify RS256 signature; also verify aud=client_id and iss.
Auto-role: any Microsoft-authenticated user in the required group is automatically assigned role=admin on first insert. Consider explicit admin approval or role provisioning.
JWT_SECRET falls back to secrets.token_hex(32) if unset -> all sessions invalidate on backend restart. Keep JWT_SECRET set in .env (it is).
check_user_in_group returns False on any Graph error (including 403 Insufficient privileges). Confirmed still needed until GroupMember.Read.All Application permission is granted on the Azure app.

Cookies are set with secure=False. Backend is served over HTTPS via ingress; consider secure=True + samesite='none' for cross-site scenarios (current samesite='lax' works because frontend and backend share the origin).
server.py is 792 lines - consider splitting into modules (auth, dataverse, admin, cms) for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 3 login flows validated - MS redirect, bypass toggle, bypass submit)

seed_data_creation: Test suite forges idTokens for qa.teste.*, nogroup.*, othergroup.*, wrongtid.* accounts @sociedadesaojoaodaslampas.pt. A cleanup fixture (scope=module, autouse) deletes these users from the MongoDB 'users' collection after tests complete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Microsoft SSO backend flow (/api/auth/microsoft) is validated end-to-end via forged JWTs (backend decodes without signature verification). Dataverse integration works with new client secret (327 socios). Full regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (42 tests) + /app/backend/tests/test_microsoft_sso.py (9 tests). To run: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=test_database python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Real Microsoft SSO login by end-user is not testable in automation - must be validated with a real @sociedadesaojoaodaslampas.pt account belonging to Orgaos Sociais group. Note: Graph memberOf fallback still requires GroupMember.Read.All Application permission consent on Azure app (pending). Once groups claim is present in the idToken (which happens when Azure app is configured to emit group claims), the fallback is not needed.
rca of the issue: Original bug: users logged in via MS SSO were getting logged out despite valid group membership. RCA (already fixed by main agent before this test run): (1) Invalid AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET in backend/.env -> both Dataverse and Graph token requests failed; (2) check_user_in_group only used MS Graph memberOf which returned 403 Insufficient privileges (missing GroupMember.Read.All Application permission). Fix verified: (a) new secret in .env, Dataverse now returns 327 socios and Graph token acquires (see test_dataverse_status PASS); (b) group check now inspects idToken 'groups' claim first and only falls back to Graph -> test_success_valid_domain_tenant_and_group PASSES with only the groups claim (Graph is not called). (c) Frontend only calls MSAL logoutRedirect on 401/403; on 5xx it just shows an error message (verified by code review of AdminLoginPage.js lines 39-49).
